snippet.title: Paper Mario: Tower of Trials - Overview Trailer + v3.0 Teaser
snippet.description:
*Tower of Trials* is a mod for the original GameCube release of TTYD, which puts a Rogue-like spin on its combat, offering a choice of rewards after every battle.  The core combat systems have been rebalanced, with tons of new partner moves added, and tons of additional features and settings to make every run feel unique.  The final update, v3.00, adds several new options (including an official "Random" preset to facilitate running with an unmodifiable random set of options), achievements and quality-of-life changes.

You can check out Tower of Trials for yourself here:
https://github.com/jdaster64/ttyd-tot
Join my Discord server for updates and chat about the project (and games, music, and other stuff as well):
https://discord.gg/n7gfrn5

This project is a non-profit fan work unaffiliated with Nintendo, and I make no claims to ownership of the characters, settings, etc. involved.  You can support the original developers' work by purchasing the Switch release of TTYD on Nintendo's eShop or at many physical and online retailers!
